analysis.purpose: cmdContext implements the `crib context` CLI command. It resolves either a bulk scope (package/file/cluster) or a single symbol id, validates the arguments, opens the verb/index store, and prints the requested symbol dossier as formatted JSON to stdout.
responsibilities: Detect bulk scope flags and dispatch to cmdContextByScope
Extract a single positional symbol id from the argument list
Print usage and return BAD_ARGS when no id is provided
Open the verb/index store via openVerbs
Return NOT_INDEXED if the store cannot be opened
Call verbs.context with optional flags and emit formatted JSON output
Close the index store before returning

businessRules.rule: Scope flags take precedence over single-symbol context
businessRules.rationale: If scopeOf(args) returns a scope, the function immediately returns cmdContextByScope(args, scope, ctx)

businessRules.rule: A single-symbol id must be a non-flag positional argument
businessRules.rationale: The id is found via args.find((a) => !a.startsWith('-'))
When !id, the function writes usage to stderr and returns EXIT.BAD_ARGS

businessRules.rule: Context modifiers are enabled only when their flags are present
businessRules.rationale: withSource, withRules, withFramework, and extractedOnly are included only if the corresponding args.includes check is true

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: CLI arguments including optional scope flags, symbol id, and context modifiers

sideEffects: Writes usage text to process.stderr when arguments are missing
Writes formatted JSON to process.stdout on success
Opens and closes the index store via openVerbs
errorBehavior: openVerbs failure returns EXIT.NOT_INDEXED without writing output
Unrecognized arguments are ignored rather than rejected
invariants: The index store is closed before the function returns (both success and NOT_INDEXED paths)
Only one of the two paths executes: bulk scope or single id
preconditions: A valid symbol id or recognized scope flag must be present
The crib index must be openable for the current working directory
postconditions: Either the requested dossier JSON is printed or an error code is returned
risks: Flag parsing is manual and permissive; typos in flags silently disable features
Unresolved built-ins (process.stdout.write, JSON.stringify) and several callees are not modeled
Assumes openVerbs returns a closable index object
whatToDistrust: 5 call sites resolve to no indexed symbol (Array.find, String.startsWith, process.stderr.write, JSON.stringify, process.stdout.write)
Callees cmdContextByScope, openVerbs, scopeOf, find, write are resolved but their internal behavior is not validated here
